title: Open-Source Photonics Working Group
summary: Python PIC layout, open PDK references, and browser notebooks removing commercial EDA license barriers.
description: Develops accessible simulation workflows built on gdsfactory, KLayout SiEPIC-Tools, Meep FDTD, and Femwell so Egyptian students can learn photonic integrated circuit layout on standard laptops or Colab.
requirements: Volunteer lab mentors comfortable with Python or FDTD
Host university computer labs for introductory hands-on tutorials

title: Egypt Open Photonic Chipathon Concept
summary: Team challenge pairing DRC-verified GDSII circuit layouts and inverse-design scripts with foundry sponsorship search.
description: Proposed national design challenge modeled after open-silicon chipathons across Python EDA utilities, surrogate AI models, open optical datasets, and passive silicon photonics layouts.
requirements: Multi-project wafer (MPW) shuttle sponsorship for fabricated student designs
University optical bench partners for post-fabrication characterization

milestones.label: Publish open PDK design rules and challenge tracks

title: Egypt Photonics Seasonal Training School
summary: Multi-day training pairing integrated waveguide physics, computational simulation, and faculty lectures.
description: Introductory and intermediate training roadmap hosted at Egyptian university campuses covering integrated optics, FDTD simulation, optical MEMS, and spectroscopy.
requirements: Host university auditorium or computer lab in Egypt
Local faculty liaison and student volunteers

title: Egypt Photonics Scientific Symposium
summary: National meeting framework convening Egyptian research labs, graduate presenters, and industry engineers.
description: Inaugural national technical symposium roadmap covering photonic circuits, optical interconnects, lasers, quantum optics, and sensing instrumentation.
requirements: Technical program reviewers across Egyptian faculties

title: National Thesis Recognition and Support Concept
summary: Proposed recognition and prototyping support for Egyptian B.Sc., M.Sc., and Ph.D. optics projects.
description: Planning-stage local charter initiative pairing future sponsor backing with faculty advisor review for student capstones, bench components, and graduation research grants.
requirements: Founding donor or industrial sponsorship commitment

title: Optica Global Fellowship and Elevation Guidance
summary: Advisory endorsement coordination connecting Egyptian researchers to Optica Foundation awards and Senior/Fellow grades.
description: Connects eligible Egyptian students and mid-career researchers to official Optica Foundation calls (FiO/CLEO Travel, Siegman Laser School, Women Scholars, Amplify) and Senior Member/Fellow endorsement contacts.
requirements: Active Optica membership per official Optica criteria on optica.org

milestones.label: Coordinate Senior and Fellow endorsement introductions

title: Egyptian School and Campus Optics Roadshow
summary: Hands-on light demonstrations and university orientation sessions across Cairo, Delta, and Upper Egypt.
description: Volunteer-led outreach connecting regional universities and secondary schools with bench demonstrations, chapter startup clinics, and introductory optics sessions.
requirements: School or university science coordinator hosting invitation

milestones.label: Open host school and campus request queue
